Cell.Data: (0) In cell A1, replace "my_plan" with the name of the DUT. Row 3 must contain the versions of all documentation references (FS/AS/etc.) used in this plan. Column B may be used to provide a unique and unchanging number foreach feature.

(1) The columns C, D and E are about WHAT features shall be tested. This section shall be captured first. This section must be reviewed by the Arhcitects, Designers and at least one other Verifier. Feature columns may be added or removed depending on how many levels of hierarchy your plan requires.

(2) The columns F, G and H are about HOW a feature will be verified. Column F is used to describe how to configure the DUT, and what input stimulus is required. Column G defines the check that the ENV must make to ensure the DUT operation is correct. Column H describes the measurement that is made to prove that the feature has been tested.
(3) Column I provides the path WHERE the functional coverage code (coverage_group or cover_property) is located.

(4) Columns J and K contain the measured coverage results from simulations/regressions. Cells J2 and K2 contain the overall results for this block. The coverage group testing results is in column J and coverage property result is in column K.

(5) Column H contains review/waiver comments. Near the end of the verification process all features with 100% coverage should be reviewed by the architect, designer and verification engineer. If it is decided that less than 100% coverage is acceptable, comments capturing this descision should be placed in this column.
